en: Colorized vintage view over a calm lake or pond with a small rowboat in the foreground. A bridge crosses the water on the left, while on the right shore stand several multi‑story houses with red roofs and a large church-like building behind trees. The scene is labeled at the bottom in German with the city and the specific place name. Narrow vertical publisher text appears along the left margin.
